scope: Prepared source workflow. Gameplay, persistence reload and teaching quality await final acceptance.
storage: Defaulted TrainingPlan field on the existing per-player coach_profile; copied by CopyCoachProfile. No new weak_map or profile reset.
entry_points: Lobby coach menu: my training plan

stages.1: Chosen lesson; player decides when to practice
stages.2: Five qualifying exchanges in the matching focused exercise
stages.3: A separate application round without the exercise counter

reason_codes.1: Opponent height advantage near the selected damage event
reason_codes.2: Long observed sight interval before the selected damage event

progress: Checkpoint matching exercise progress 1..4 when it changes. Five completed exchanges advance to application through the existing completion handler.
continuation: Restore stage and exercise progress. A resumed angle exercise establishes a fresh positional reference before counting its next qualifying angle change.
application_completion: A finished personal round explicitly bound to this plan revision, with attributed incoming or outgoing damage. Winning and proof of using the exact technique are not asserted.
revision_guards: Practice and application bind to a saved plan revision. Replacing a plan requires an explicit product choice while reviewing a round. New recommendations do not silently replace an active plan.
automatic_rounds: A matching unfinished plan exercise can continue across automatic rounds when PreserveExercise is requested. A separate application round starts from the plan action.
